correctness.rationale: Represent each minimal rank-one nilpotent A=u alpha, alpha(u)=0 modulo nonzero scalar. If AB=C=u0 beta0 is nonzero, normalized A=u0 alpha and B=x beta0 satisfy alpha(u0)=beta0(x)=0, alpha(x)=1; restricted pairing of two (n−1)-spaces is nondegenerate at tr(C)≠0 and has 1-d radicals at tr(C)=0, yielding both fiber sizes. Counting image lines in ker alpha yields F(0); reversal gives BA=tr(C)*x alpha. Independent literal matrix-product enumeration checked every target for (n,q)=(2,2),(2,3),(3,2),(3,3),(4,2), including nilpotent support obstruction for n=2. Algebra is valid all finite fields, including characteristic2.
